newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-WP 220 AND 31-0, NORTHERN TRANSVAAL 355.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WP 220 AND 31-0, NORTHERN TRANSVAAL 355.

text.p: their grip on their Supersport Series match with Western
Province on the second day at Newlands on Saturday.
Northerns belied last season's lowly seventh place finish in
the Castle Cup by taking a commanding 135-run first innings lead
They added 260 to their overnight 95 for two with key
contributions from Richie Richardson (56) and Roy Pienaar (95)
who put on 112 for the third wicket.
Pienaar's four hour stay was finally ended when he edged
Brett Schultz to slip to give the former South African pace
bowler his first wicket since joining Western Province.
Schultz finished with two for 95 from 26 overs as he and his
colleagues were unable to finish off the tail.
Dan van Zyl (35) put on 47 with Steve Elworthy (40) for the
seventh wicket while Province were further held up by a useful
10th wicket partnership of 33 between Greg Smith (11) and Rudi
Western Province survived the remaining 12 overs of the day
